# Make seurat object. This one is just going to be used for clustering information for soupx.
```{r}
make_seurat = function(path_to_data, output_name) {
  counts = Read10X(data.dir = path_to_data)
  umis = counts$"Gene Expression"
  htos = counts$"Antibody Capture"
  
  joint_bcs = intersect(colnames(umis), colnames(htos))
  umis = umis[, joint_bcs]
  htos = as.matrix(htos[, joint_bcs])
  
  htos = htos[1:6,] # based on number of HTOs used in experiment
  seu = CreateSeuratObject(counts = umis)
  seu[["HTO"]] = CreateAssayObject(counts = htos)
  
  seu = NormalizeData(seu, assay = "HTO", normalization.method = "CLR")
  seu = HTODemux(seu, assay = "HTO", positive.quantile = 0.95)
  
  seu = ScaleData(seu)
  seu = FindVariableFeatures(seu)
  seu = RunPCA(seu)
  seu = RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:10)
  seu = FindNeighbors(seu)
  seu = FindClusters(seu)
  
  saveRDS(seu, output_name)
  return(seu)
}

seu_sample_1 = make_seurat(path_to_data = "input_data/cellranger_complete_output/Sample1/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/", output_name = "rds_objects/1_raw_seu_clustered_sample_1.rds")
seu_sample_2 = make_seurat(path_to_data = "input_data/cellranger_complete_output/Sample2/filtered_feature_bc_matrix/", output_name = "rds_objects/1_raw_seu_clustered_sample_2.rds")

```


# Run soupx. 
```{r}
run_soupx = function(cr_path, raw_seu_path, output_path) {
  cr = load10X(cr_path)
  seu = readRDS(raw_seu_path)
  clusters = seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters
  names(clusters) = rownames(seu@meta.data)
  
  sc = setClusters(cr, clusters)
  sc = autoEstCont(sc)
  sc = adjustCounts(sc)
  
  no_soup_seu = CreateSeuratObject(sc)
  
  no_soup_seu@meta.data = merge(no_soup_seu@meta.data, seu@meta.data %>% select(HTO_classification.global, hash.ID), by = "row.names") %>%
    column_to_rownames("Row.names")
  
  # Filter out cells with > 25% mitochondrial gene expression, < 800 transcript reads, or < 200 genes. 
  no_soup_seu = PercentageFeatureSet(object = no_soup_seu, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt", assay = "RNA")
  no_soup_seu = subset(no_soup_seu, subset = nFeature_RNA >= 200 & nCount_RNA >= 800 & percent.mt <= 25)
  
  saveRDS(no_soup_seu, output_path)
  return(no_soup_seu)
}

no_soup_sample_1 = run_soupx(cr_path = "input_data/cellranger_complete_output/Sample1", raw_seu_path = "rds_objects/1_raw_seu_clustered_sample_1.rds", output_path = "rds_objects/2_no_soup_sample_1.rds")
no_soup_sample_2 = run_soupx(cr_path = "input_data/cellranger_complete_output/Sample2", raw_seu_path = "rds_objects/1_raw_seu_clustered_sample_2.rds", output_path = "rds_objects/2_no_soup_sample_2.rds")

```

# Testing for 11994 monocytes with new CellRanger output.
```{r}
monocyte_data = Read10X_h5("input_data/11994-JVA/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

seu = CreateSeuratObject(monocyte_data$`Gene Expression`)
seu[["HTO"]] = CreateAssayObject(monocyte_data$`Antibody Capture`)

seu = NormalizeData(seu, assay = "HTO", normalization.method = "CLR")
seu = HTODemux(seu, assay = "HTO", positive.quantile = 0.95)

seu = ScaleData(seu)
seu = FindVariableFeatures(seu)
seu = RunPCA(seu)
seu = RunUMAP(seu, dims = 1:10)
seu = FindNeighbors(seu)
seu = FindClusters(seu)

saveRDS(seu, "rds_objects/1_raw_seu_clustered_11994_monocytes.rds")
```

# Testing soupx with new CellRanger.
```{r}
cr_example = load10X("first_submission/input_data/cellranger_complete_output/Sample1")

cellranger_raw = Read10X_h5("input_data/11994-JVA/raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
seu = readRDS("rds_objects/1_raw_seu_clustered_11994_monocytes.rds")
cr_test = SoupChannel(tod = cellranger_raw$`Gene Expression`, toc = seu@assays$RNA@counts)

clusters = seu@meta.data$seurat_clusters
names(clusters) = rownames(seu@meta.data)

sc = setClusters(cr_test, clusters)
sc = autoEstCont(sc)
sc = adjustCounts(sc)

no_soup_seu = CreateSeuratObject(sc)

no_soup_seu@meta.data = merge(no_soup_seu@meta.data, seu@meta.data %>% select(HTO_classification.global, hash.ID), by = "row.names") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Row.names")

# Filter out cells with > 25% mitochondrial gene expression, < 800 transcript reads, or < 200 genes. 
no_soup_seu = PercentageFeatureSet(object = no_soup_seu, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt", assay = "RNA")
no_soup_seu = subset(no_soup_seu, subset = nFeature_RNA >= 200 & nCount_RNA >= 800 & percent.mt <= 25)

saveRDS(no_soup_seu, "rds_objects/2_no_soup_11994_monocytes.rds")
```
